game: Mega Man Battle Network 6: Cybeast Gregar (USA)
about: Addresses, names and descriptions only: facts about the ROM, read from Cyberworld Endless's own sources (src/emu/*.h, src/core/rom.c, docs/ROM_DATA.md). No graphics, text, sound or code of the game. See docs/SYMBOLS.md.

14.title: Chip records (0x2C bytes)
14.how: Verify by listing the records whose words at 0x24 and 0x28 are equal: 34, all left out by the other rules but 275-277.

15.title: Chip names
15.how: Text archives found by encoding "Cannon" with the game's character table; pointers in code reference both.

16.title: Chip descriptions
16.how: Verify: script 1 of the first reads "Cannon to / attack / 1 enemy", script 0 of the second "Attk ahd. / Suck in & / shoot out" as in the disassembly.

19.how: Check by drawing indices 1-0x4F of the picture with that cut: no 6 pixels remain and the N keeps its outline.

20.title: Title marks
20.how: Check with `build.py shot --scene title --marks 1FE`: each mark whole, in its colours, where BN6 puts it.

21.title: Boot and warps
21.how: Found in the bn6f disassembly and tested in `tools/romlab`.

22.title: The game's structures read field by field
22.how: Verified by `CYBERWORLD_STATE_POS=1`, whose state prints MegaMan's position and every NPC's (`npc N ... at x y z`) where they stand on the map, and by an autopilot run whose log is the same, line for line, as before the names.

23.title: Encounter roll

24.title: Battle events by hook
24.how: Verify: an autopilot run's log is the same as before.

25.title: Map, flag and key item events by hook
25.how: Verify: an autopilot run's log is the same as before; a layer's challenge and its Undernet warp start on a Yes (`tools/play.py start ch --fresh --seed 31 -- --scene emu --run-depth 4 --dev quiet --talk challenge:300`; `--seed 41`, `--run-depth 4 --net-biome 4 --talk undernet:300`); a ScrtData picked up is counted and MegaMan says what it is for (`--seed 53`, `--run-depth 5`: its Mystery Data at 348, -44, MegaMan put beside it with the dev step `place 328 -44 0`); a guardian's exit pad stays shut after each battle on its layer and after a CONTINUE there.

26.title: BN6's wait for a frame
26.how: Verify: the autopilot's debug log and run log are the same with and without it, and `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG`'s 30-frame line counts about four more hook hits a frame (each interrupt that wakes the CPU before VBlank brings it back to the loop).

28.title: Map takeover
28.how: Verify: `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=weak build.py shot --scene emu --seed 1 --setup short,0,0,0 --frames 32000`, home after each act, wins the Nest (the runlog's `run over at depth 10`).

29.title: Lan's HP
29.how: Verify: `--scene home --run-depth 7 --marks 08` shows two link markers lit beside the pink pad; MegaMan on the link up top warps to the other way's layer ("home: way 1 taken" with `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1`), R asks BN6's "MegaMan, jack out?", and its yes sets Lan down at his PC.

30.how: Verify: `--scene town` starts a run in Lan's room at -62, 80; `0:place -40 -8 7` and R play Lan's "Jack in!" into Lan's HP's blue pad (`build.py screenshots home-pc`); down the room's stairs and out of the front door Lan stands by his house in the planned town (`town-central`).

31.how: Verify: `--scene town`, in at AsterLand's door, A facing the blue machine from its front (`0:place 92 48 7`, a step up) plays BN6's "It's a Chip Trader."; the green one (`0:place 112 48 7`) the "Out of order" sign; the board (`0:place -76 -38 7`) BN6's "A request board." and an empty RqustBBS; in the Academy the foyer walked through from its gate to the turnstile, the hallways and class 6-1 crossed without a warp back.

33.how: Verify: `--scene town --dev zenny=8000`, at AsterLand's register the clerk's list with Cannon A at 1000 zenny; ordered, "I bought "Cannon A"!", 7000 zenny, and his "That's your order for today!" after; the seller beside him: MiniEnrg, FullEnrg, SneakRun, Untrap; the second screen names the chip under the order's cursor.

60.title: BN6's own DarkChips: DrkSword, DarkThnd, DrkRecov, DarkInvs, DarkPlus
60.how: Verify, as seen headless with a throwaway hook (not committed) that wrote the folder in code * and marked it owned as own_folder_chips does, set the BugFrags through GiveBugfrags or TakeBugfrags and raised the battle's enemies to 2000 HP (`--seed 13`, its first battle a Mettaur): with 5 BugFrags DrkSword dealt 400 in a magenta crescent (a Mettaur two columns ahead and a row down deleted, a Starfish three columns ahead untouched), the BugFrags 5 to 4 at the use, save and battle's copy alike, the HP bug 2; DarkThnd 200, a purple Thunder ball, the Mettaur paralysed, the HP bug 1; DrkRecov 50 to 1050 of 2000 HP, the HP bug 7, then 1 HP each 10 frames; DarkInvs a time freeze named DarkInvs, then 480 frames of MegaMan as a green phantom slashing and firing his held Cannon on his own, LEFT held for 200 frames not keeping him in the back column, untouched by the Mettaur's shockwaves; DarkPlus after a Cannon left the HUD at "Cannon 40" with two chip icons and dealt 40 (Atk+10 in its place: "Cannon 40+10"), and alone made a puff, took a BugFrag and gave the HP bug 4.

69.how: Found beside their internet counterparts in bn6f `asm03_1_0.s` and `asm03_0.s` (the real-world tables come first, 7 entries each); each pointer read from the Gregar ROM leads to its group's code or lists.

73.how: Found in Gregar as the literal (pool word `0x08040790`) of the second of three look-alike routines (`0x08040768`, bn6f `chatbox_selectCompTextByMap_8040794`); Central Town's table `0x0804F800` gives scripts 0-4, none, 6-10, 12, 13 for checks 0-12, ACDC Town's 0-7.

81.title: Props' map objects
81.how: Found in each map's object list (the group's spawner's first `ldr r1, [pc, #imm]` literal) and checked by spawning each in a generated layer and in its own place.

82.title: The NaviCust's Spins
82.how: CheckKeyItem (bn6f `0x0803CE2C`) answers 0 for an item whose check byte (`+0x78` array) differs from its seed (`0x020004E0` array) XOR `0x55`: Gregar's code at `0x006E3C` writes the check as the game gives an item, `0x006E50` tests it (Falzar's key is `0x6F`).

84.title: Net maps' backdrops and animations
84.how: Verify: in romlab, warped into each BN5 map, its BG palette (`0x05000000`, dumped every 32 frames) changes in those banks and no others; with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xbackdrop: ... map 0x90:0's backdrop and animations for 0x90:0" (0x93:0 for 0x91:1, 0x94:3 for 0x92:0), a capture of `--net-biome x0`, `x2` or `x3` over a few hundred frames shows BN5's backdrop moving and the GFXAnim slots at `0x020094C0` naming the copies, and BN6's own areas (`--seed 11` dresses none) draw frame for frame as without BN5.

85.title: Battle backgrounds
85.how: Verify: with BN5 beside BN6, `CYBERWORLD_EMU_DEBUG=1` prints "xbackdrop: background 8 ... as 0x16" (10, 15 and 25 as 0x17-0x19), and a battle on `--net-biome x0` to `x3` (`--seed 2`, the autopilot finds one) shows BN5's background: ACDC Area's blue diamonds, SciLab's scrolling binary, End Area's red field of diamonds, Nebula Area's still stars.

86.how: Verify: in a run, the PET shows Save lit and Comm grey; A on Comm buzzes, A on Save closes the PET and "Run saved" shows.

87.title: The PET's KeyItem and E-Mail words
87.how: Verify: in a run, KeyItem lists NaviCode and LibCard with their words, and E-Mail a mail from Dad per guardian met, its body the guardian's warning.

88.how: Verify: `--dev gem` puts one in every random battle; win without touching it and the results give a second reward (980 zenny on layer 3), hit it and it breaks.

100.how: Verify: `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=1 python3 build.py shot --scene emu --seed 3 --frames 15000` wins seed 3's depth-2 Piranhas at 100 HP (`runlog.txt`), where the button rhythm the autopilot had used, still `weak`'s, picked an Atk+10 alone and was deleted.

108.title: The Custom screen's window
108.how: Verify: the same, in any battle.

109.how: Verify: with Custom1 in the PET, `play.py` dev step `flags 9832 9835 1` (0x2668-0x266B; the step reaches every flag of eEventFlags' 1448 bytes, `BN6_EVENT_FLAG_BYTES`, bn6f's ewram.s) draws it in its four-block shape on the NaviCust screen; with it placed and SuperArmor's flags 0x2664-0x2667 set too, MegaMan says SuperArmor needs a program moved, where uncompressed it would not fit the 4x4 board at all.

118.how: Verify: `CYBERWORLD_AUTOPILOT=weak python3 build.py shot --scene emu --seed 1 --setup short,0,0,0 --frames 70000`: three trips home and a won run in the run log.

120.how: Verify: `python3 tools/play.py start NAME --fresh --seed 6 -- --scene emu --run-depth 2 --dev quiet,pack=12 --talk trader:1700`, the arrival's chats paged, and `second` at the trader's words and on its screen: "The Pack holds 12" both times.

121.title: The second screen's NaviCustomizer
121.how: Verified on 5 October 2026 in a run through `tools/play.py` with `--dev programs=8` and the memory watched: DOWN moved +0x20, and +0x24 past the fourth row; A took Custom1 up (+0x02 `0x10`, then `0x14`) and A placed it (`0x04`; the placed list's first entry `0x08` at column 3, row 2; the list lost its entry); LEFT went to the board (`0x08`), A on a placed program offered move and remove (`0x1C`), and move held it (`0x20`, `0x24`), its entry back in the list.

122.title: The second screen's battle
122.how: Verified on 5 October 2026 in battles played through `tools/play.py` with `CYBERWORLD_WATCH` on each: Sword and Atk+10 taken, the hand read `0x47`, power `0x50` and bonus `0x0A` as the HUD showed "Sword 80+10"; UP opened CROSSSELECT (`0x4C`, then `0x54`) and B shut it (`0x50`, then `0x04`); with HeatCross, ElecCross and SlashCross the row ran 0-2 over HEAT, ELEC and SLASH; with ElecCross's flag off HEAT and SLASH stood at rows 0 and 1; with MegaMan in HeatCross, SLASH alone at row 0.

123.title: The second screen's contexts
123.how: Verified on 5 October 2026 in a run played through `tools/play.py` with `CYBERWORLD_WATCH='*020093B0:1,02001B80:2,*020093E4:64'` (the debug output's memory watch): START gave GameState `0x18`; ChipFolder the main index `0x28` and the screen `0x00`; EDIT `0x20`; MegaMan `0x0C`; his NaviCust `0x24`.

124.how: Flag `0x173E`, tested next, is the SlipRun state: the player's update clears it every frame (bn6f `ow_player.s`), so setting it does nothing.
